DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION

Airline Refunds and Other Consumer Protections

DATES: As of July 7, 2026, the Department is extending the limited enforcement
discretion described in this notice for one year from publication, expiring on July
7, 2027. The extension is limited to the renumbered-flight circumstances described
in the notice; the underlying refund requirements remain in effect.
